name: barre
title: Barre
description: A ballet and dance school theme set like the end-of-year recital programme: pale satin-pink card, black ink and one deep rose, with a fold crease down the page and every class laid out as a cast line — the time ranged right to the crease, the class in spaced capitals beside it, teacher and age group in italic beneath.

tokens.--font-display: the spaced capitals: site title, page titles, day names, class names, instructor names, section headings, menu and table headings (light geometric)
tokens.--font-body: body text, the italic roles (teacher, level, discipline, dates), the class times and the act labels (old-style serif)
tokens.--weight-display: weight of the largest capitals: page titles and day names
tokens.--weight-caps: weight of the smaller capitals: site title, menu, class names, instructor names, section and table headings
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the spaced capitals
tokens.--tracking-title: wider letter spacing of the site title in the masthead and footer
tokens.--text-s: small text: menu links, small capital labels, table headings, footer
tokens.--text-m: base body size; also the site title on phones and the Today flag
tokens.--text-l: the site title, the intro line under a page title, the act labels, class times, instructor names in the list, the first-class note, quotes and small headings in page text
tokens.--text-cast: class names in the timetable and section headings in page text
tokens.--text-xl: the day names that head each act of the timetable
tokens.--leading-tight: line height of headings, class names and times
tokens.--color-bg: the programme's cover — pale pointe-satin pink ground behind the masthead, page titles, the card and the footer
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, class names, instructor names and the menu
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: teacher and level lines, disciplines and dates, instructor summaries, the timetable heading, table headings, page numbers, quotes and the footer
tokens.--color-accent: deep ribbon rose: links, the Book a trial class link, the current menu item, the act labels, the diamond where the crease begins, the first-class note, today's day name and flag, list markers and the focus ring
tokens.--color-panel: background of alternate table rows, code and selected text, on the card
tokens.--color-card: the open programme: the lighter card that holds the timetable, the instructor list and page text, with the crease down its middle
tokens.--shadow-card: the soft shadow that lifts the card off the ground
tokens.--color-crease: the dark line of the fold crease down the card
tokens.--color-crease-light: the thin highlight on the right lip of the crease
tokens.--color-shade: the soft shadow falling into the crease from the left (wide screens)
tokens.--page-width: maximum width of the spread either side of the crease
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of reading text and of the centred intro lines
tokens.--gutter: space between the page edge and the content
tokens.--side-gap: space between the crease and the text on either side of it (wide screens)
tokens.--card-pad: space inside the card either side of the spread (wide screens)
tokens.--time-col: on phones, the width of the left side (times, disciplines, the timetable label on a person's page) before the crease
tokens.--space-2: small gap: between class lines and around the centred lines
tokens.--space-3: base step: paragraph spacing, padding beside centred lines, the crease gap on phones
tokens.--space-4: gap between acts of the timetable and between sections
tokens.--space-5: space at the foot of the card, between the timetable and the page text, and above the timetable link on a person's page, and below the footer
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the card, photos, code blocks and the focus ring
tokens.--focus-width: thickness of the keyboard focus ring
tokens.--tap-target: minimum touch height of menu and pagination links
tokens.--photo-ratio: portrait shape as width divided by height (0.8 is a 4:5 portrait)
tokens.--portrait-max: widest the portrait on an instructor's own page may get
